1. Low-risk customers may be eligible for simplified due diligence measures under the Financial Intelligence Centre Act (FICA), as long as it is part of a risk mitigation strategy and complies with regulatory requirements to manage ML/TF risks effectively.
2. Relevant Regulatory Basis: Section 63, Implementation Guidance Note 7 A – Financial Intelligence Centre Act (FICA), 2001 as retrieved from [Source 1] Chunk 11070 of the document titled "Revised-Guidance-Note-7A–Implementation-of-various-aspects-of-the-FIC-Act.txt".

Explanation: The guidance note specifies that institutions should use customer due diligence as a measure to mitigate ML/TF risks, which implies the possibility of simplified measures for low-risk customers within an effective risk management framework under FICA regulations. However, it is essential to ensure these simplifications do not compromise regulatory compliance and that they are adequately documented as part of a comprehensive RMCP (Risk Management Control Plan).
